positioning: Protect existing revenue stores from AI experimentation while allowing controlled tests on new/sandbox stores.

experimental_new_store.description: New or test store. AI may draft and queue experiments, but human confirmation and stop-loss review are still required.

protected_legacy_store.description: Existing or unknown store. AI may analyze and draft only. Store-impacting execution requires explicit protection override.

locked_revenue_store.description: Stable, high-GMV, old, or active-ad store. AI must not disturb ads, listing, price, discounts, inventory, links, coupons, or live-room settings.

notes: Unknown stores are protected by default.
Old stores, active-ad stores, stable sales stores and high-GMV stores require explicit protection override before any execution.
AI can always analyze, draft, score and recommend, but cannot execute store-impacting actions automatically.
New/test stores may be used for controlled experiments after human confirmation.
